name: ECSS-E-ST-10-03C space-segment equipment thermal vacuum test (<= 1e-5 hPa, functional tests at hot and cold)
plain_name: Test a satellite electronics unit in vacuum under the European space testing standard
description: Equipment-level thermal vacuum test per ECSS-E-ST-10-03C clause 5.5.4: equipment that operates in space vacuum is tested at 10-5 hPa (1e-3 Pa) or less, with functional tests at the hot and cold operating temperatures, a dwell of at least 2 h before functional tests and a non-operating cycle.
keywords: Test a satellite electronics unit in vacuum under the European space testing standard

requirements.rationale: Clause 5.5.4.2a: equipment operating in space vacuum must be tested in thermal vacuum.
Functional tests at hot and cold operating temperatures require powered, instrumented equipment inside the chamber.
Optional: functional tests start only after a dwell of at least 2 h, so the facility must hold a plateau for at least 2 h.
